svg.aria-label: Two toy steps: the canvas moves, each label difference is read at each step, and the eight numbers are laid end to end into a score path.
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Two steps stack into a score path of 8 numbers
Each label's d is read at every step along the product's own path, then the steps are laid end to end.
d(7) at step 1 is [0, 0, -1, 0], not [0, 0, -1, -2]: its v part reads x,
and x has moved. A path depends on where the canvas has been.
The score paths: step 0 then step 1
S(3)+S(7) is the product's path: what PoE adds, step by step.
S(joint) uses a pair label the real digit models do not have;
its d is d(3)+d(7)+r with r = [0, 1, 1, 1], the toy interaction term.
Real size: 16 steps x 32 x 64 pixels = 32,768 numbers per path.
A hand-set toy: 4 pixels, 2 steps, integer weights. It shows where each term sits and predicts nothing about the digit models. Numbers: miniature_answer_key.json, steps and score_paths.
